blocks.text: Administration means governance or management. It matters in both secular and spiritual contexts, serving as a tool for orderliness and sanity in the church - {{tt 1:5|Titus 1:5}}, {{1co 14:40|1 Corinthians 14:40}}, {{ex 18:13,ex 18:14,ex 18:15,ex 18:16,ex 18:17,ex 18:18,ex 18:19,ex 18:20,ex 18:21,ex 18:22,ex 18:23,ex 18:24,ex 18:25,ex 18:26|Exodus 18:13-26}}, {{act 6:1,act 6:2,act 6:3,act 6:4,act 6:5|Acts 6:1-5}}.
Good church administration draws on a number of management tools:

items: A consistent search for available and faithful people - {{mt 25:14,mt 25:15,mt 25:16,mt 25:17,mt 25:18,mt 25:19,mt 25:20,mt 25:21,mt 25:22,mt 25:23,mt 25:24,mt 25:25,mt 25:26,mt 25:27,mt 25:28,mt 25:29|Matthew 25:14-29}}.
